inputs.text: [serious] A herbivore. He grazed on plants in a big herd, [calm] young and old together. [confident] In America, Albertosaurus hunted him. In Asia, it was Tarbosaurus.
[curious] And what was his crest for?
[confident] Unlike Parasaurolophus, [curious] it didn't echo like a trumpet. [hesitant] Scientists think it was just for being seen and recognized by the rest of the herd.
